newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London firm in London trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London firm in London trading.

text.p: U.S. stocks were mostly holding firm in London trading on Wednesday after Tuesday's Wall Street surge which carried the Dow up 2.6 percent to its highest level since late March, dealers said.
The Dow was seen opening mixed-to-firm and participants said the market looked to have further upside after aparently shaking free of its recent correction.

Yet first-quarter earnings from bellwether stock International Business Machines Corp, due after today's New York close, could help determine the market's short-term direction, dealers said. IBM was quoted down $1/4 at $139-1/4.
Dealers pointed out that a number of other significant earnings reports were due today, including Chevron and United Technologies.
"There are a lot of big companies reporting today," said one dealer in U.S. equities here, "but all eyes will be on IBM."

Like other major international corporations, IBM's profits are expected to have been squeezed by the strength of the dollar and the computer giant was expected to report earnings of $2.28 a share, down from $2.48 a year ago.
Dealers said a positive surprise from IBM could be the cue for further stockmarket gains.
